verification: Compared every copied source and destination by SHA-256 and every symlink by target text. Main has identical source and destination path sets, including working-tree records. All eight symlinks resolve in both places.
auxiliary_scope: Outside the full main tree, include project and branch documents, the May research-map backup, research sources, experiment records, configurations, tables including Parquet, figures, statistical fits and resampling, and files that combine measurements with training trajectories. Runtime environments, corpus payloads, language-model weights and raw tensor caches are held on the execution side.
digest_format: For each scope, SHA-256 of sorted archive-relative Path entries serialized as compact UTF-8 JSON lines [path, kind, size, content_sha256_or_link_target]. Link size is zero.
